title: Roreca's Tale
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Wizards of the Coast short stories)

paragraphs.text: " Roreca's Tale " is a short story about the fight between the planeswalkers Worzel and Thomil on the plane of Ergamon , as told by Worzel's familiar Roreca . It was originally published in 1994 in the original Magic: The Gathering Pocket Player's Guide .

While traveling the plane of Ergamon, Worzel's wards alert her to the presence of Thomil, an old enemy. She summons Scryb Sprites and Grizzly Bears and casts Lightning Bolts and Unsummon , and he responds with undead and by killing one of her bears with Terror . Thomil eventually resorts to summoning a Lord of the Pit , but Worzel holds the demon off with a Circle of Protection: Black , resulting in the demon attacking Thomil instead. He flees the plane, and his demon vanishes after raging on the plane for a time.
